payload.body: Typed interfaces do not yet establish a mechanically or biologically integrated fish. The pinned coupling document registers no biological calibration and explicitly refuses several scale transfers. I read that document and this Project member; this is an authored design challenge, not an independent experimental review.

design_review.scope: Composition of the exact pinned model-coupling member into a whole-organism design.
design_review.alternative: A collection of individually executable models may remain incompatible in biological context, units, time scale, or boundary conditions.
design_review.falsifiable_next_test: Select one connection with real input/output artifacts, specify its domain and units, freeze the numerical acceptance bound before the run, and compare propagated predictions against withheld measured outputs. Until such a biological calibration exists, retain scenario or refused status.

payload.body: The indexed molecule-to-fin source does not supply an executable genotype-to-wing-area map for this Project. Its Evidence record is a documentary source assessment, and the Project explicitly declares no causal bridge. An association or structural prediction alone does not specify a viable flying-fish design.

design_review.scope: Transfer from the pinned Daane source context to fin proportions and functional flight in this candidate.
design_review.alternative: Genetic effects may depend on species, allele, developmental stage and interacting pathways; similar proportions need not imply comparable tissue mechanics or locomotion.
design_review.falsifiable_next_test: Curate exact reported organisms, alleles, phenotypes and uncertainty from the primary dataset; distinguish measured associations from causal intervention evidence; preregister a held-out genotype-to-phenotype prediction in its source context before considering species transfer.

payload.body: The pinned lift/drag member identifies a calibration need. Its read-status disagreement is explicitly preserved, and the registered Evidence is documentary metadata rather than an audited coefficient table. That member cannot currently establish this mesh's aerodynamic performance.

design_review.scope: Use of the pinned Park and Choi source member as aerodynamic calibration for the candidate geometry.
design_review.alternative: A candidate can satisfy geometric constraints while producing insufficient lift, excessive drag, or unstable motion in the intended Reynolds-number and free-surface regime.
design_review.falsifiable_next_test: Pin a primary coefficient dataset with geometry, Reynolds number and uncertainty; reproduce an appropriate reference case with grid and timestep controls, then test the exact candidate mesh in that validated regime. Record low-Re or 2D demonstrations separately from flight-regime predictions.

payload.body: The pinned Turing claim concerns onset wavelength under stated assumptions. It does not assign fin-tissue reaction rates, diffusivities or a physical length scale. A visually convincing repeated pattern is not yet evidence of correctly spaced living scales.

design_review.scope: Mapping the exact pinned Turing onset claim to physical scale spacing and mature tissue geometry.
design_review.alternative: Nonlinear history, tissue growth, boundaries and cellular interactions may change the selected pattern and invalidate a near-onset wavelength proxy.
design_review.falsifiable_next_test: Identify a measured developmental dataset with physical length/time units, infer parameters on a declared training subset, and compare nonlinear simulations with held-out spatial and temporal measurements. Preserve onset-analysis and mature-pattern predictions as distinct results.
